audience: SEO writers and content teams that plan articles in NEURONwriter

useCases.title: Get terms and questions for an article
useCases.text: List the analyses of a project, then read one analysis for its terms, questions and competitors once it is ready.

useCases.title: Score a draft before you save it
useCases.text: Score a draft, given as HTML or as a public URL, against an analysis. The check saves nothing.

useCases.title: Start an analysis for a keyword
useCases.text: Create an analysis for one keyword in a project. Its recommendations are ready after about 60 seconds.

useCases.title: Read the last saved draft
useCases.text: Get the last content revision saved in the editor for one analysis. Include the autosave revisions if you need them.

useCases.title: Save a draft into the editor
useCases.text: Save article HTML or a page URL as a new revision in the editor of one analysis. Then read the saved content.
